mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after Yorick or the Maiden dies, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Starts after Yorick or the Maiden of the Mist dies

mechanics.claim: Yorick's next basic attack consumes Touch of the Maiden to deal bonus magic damage on-hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Yorick's''' next basic attack will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The Maiden's stats (and thus her AD/health scaling) update live with Yorick's stat changes and with ability rank.
mechanics.quote: The ''Maiden'' updates her stats when '''Yorick's''' [[champion statistic|stats]] change, and as ''Eulogy of the Isles'' is ranked up.

mechanics.claim: Eulogy of the Isles can be recast while the Maiden is active to release her.
mechanics.quote: ''Eulogy of the Isles'' can be recast once while the ''Maiden'' is alive after 10 seconds of the activation.

mechanics.claim: Extra Mist Walkers spawn 250 units from the Maiden's summon location, a positioning detail not a damage change.
mechanics.quote: The extra {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} spawn 250 units from the ''Maiden'' summon location.
